# CityPlace bnb, For Sale

> CityPlace bnb is a 10-unit boutique extended-stay short-term-rental property at 3604 San Jacinto St, Dallas, TX 75204, a 2-minute walk from Baylor University Medical Center (914-bed Level I trauma center). Ten identical renovated 1BR/1BA suites (~550 sqft) with full kitchens, free private parking, contactless entry, and a private dog park. Trailing-twelve-month (through June 2026) revenue is $307,946 with NOI of $176,844, on roughly four years of operating history. Appraised June 2025 at $2.43M (real estate) and $2.77M (going concern). The offering is UNPRICED: the deal page publishes verified STR actuals and an interactive slider showing cap rate and cash-on-cash at any price the buyer chooses. The full operation transfers: Cloudbeds PMS, RoomPriceGenie, a remote reservation manager with 4 years' tenure, cleaning team with backup bench, handyman, smart locks, per-unit cameras, and a Slack ops channel, run today in about 5 owner-hours/week from Austin, with an optional 2-month transition support contract. An institutional lender term sheet has been obtained at 75% LTV (80% available at DSCR >= 1.15); details in the deal room. All figures are owner-provided and independently verifiable in the deal room.

## Contact

Serious buyers should request the deal room via the form at https://cityplacebnb.com/buy/#deal-room.

## Disclosures

CityPlace bnb is offered through the owner's listing arrangements; the owner holds a Texas real estate license. All financial figures are owner-provided and independently verifiable in the deal room. Financing references reflect obtained term sheets and are subject to underwriting. The offering is unpriced. Dallas's attempted STR restrictions have repeatedly lost in court, and the property won its own platform appeal on all four points in February 2025; buyers should evaluate the regulatory landscape independently.
